artworks.title: Impronte, Pompei (Cast, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a human figure in a contorted position, with knees bent and arms wrapped around the legs. The material appears to be a light-colored plaster or stone with a rough texture. The sculpture is positioned on a dark surface, offering a stark contrast. The figure is seen from the side, showing exaggerated curves and shapes of the limbs, which twist and fold into each other in a compact manner.

artworks.title: Impronte Umane, Pompei (Human Casts, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts two human figures lying on their sides. They appear to be in relaxed poses, with one figure slightly higher than the other. The figures are made of a material resembling plaster or cast, giving them a rough, textured surface. The color of the sculptures is a pale, faded white, contrasting against the dark background they rest upon. The figures are life-sized and their features are recognizable as human, but with some erosion or damage blurring finer details. The figures are positioned next to each other in a manner suggestive of repose or sleep.

artworks.title: Impronte Umane, Pompei (Human Cast, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a human figure lying on its side, with one arm tucked under the head and the other resting along the torso. Its legs are slightly bent at the knees. The sculpture appears to be crafted from a light-colored material, possibly plaster or a similar substance, giving it a pale, stone-like appearance. The texture is visibly rough, with noticeable details that mimic the contours and features of a human body. The figure is positioned horizontally, stretched out on what seems to be a piece of dark fabric. The background is dark, drawing focus to the sculpture and its resting pose against a backdrop of slightly fragmented ground beneath it.

artworks.title: Casa di Marco Lucrezio, Pompei (House of Marco Lucrezio, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of sculptures in an ancient, partly ruined courtyard. A classical statue of a human figure is positioned atop a small staircase within an arched alcove. The statue is light in color and made of marble. Surrounding it are several secondary sculptures on pedestals. Sculpted head figures are mounted on columns at each side of the staircase. The setting includes weathered stone walls with remnants of plaster and faded frescoes. The statues are relatively small compared to the tall walls behind them.

artworks.title: Écrivain Public, Naples
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a woman seated at a wooden table outdoors. The man, on the left, is leaning slightly forward with his hands on the table holding a smoking pipe. He has a long white beard and is wearing a silver top hat with yellow fabric or ribbon. He is dressed in a dark coat. The woman, to his left, has her hands resting on the table. She has dark hair partly covered with a white headscarf and wears a pink dress with ruffles. An umbrella is overhead. The table is cluttered with papers, and a sign with handwritten text hangs off its side. The background shows a green door against a light-colored wall, with a worn fabric strip at the top.

artworks.title: Strada di Sallustio, Pompei (Street of Sallustio, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a historical urban street scene. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, providing a perspective down a cobblestone road with buildings on both sides. The buildings are made of weathered stone and brick, suggesting a previous grandeur. The scene has a warm color palette dominated by earthy browns and beiges. Two figures in historical attire are in the street, offering a sense of scale. In the distance, a faint mountain can be seen against the sky.

artworks.title: Casa del Poeta Tragico, Pompei (House of the Tragic Poet, Pompeii)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts the interior of a ruinous ancient building during the day. Visible are stone walls, a pedestal-like column, a patterned stone floor, columns, a decorative niche, and eroded textures. The palette is sepia-toned with soft contrasts of light and shadow. The horizon is not visible.

artworks.title: Interior of Fort Foote
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This image shows a military fortification with a central earthen pathway. Wooden logs line the path, leading to rounded bunker-like structures. The sepia-toned image features a horizon with trees or structures in the background. The photograph has a vintage quality, with a color palette dominated by browns and tans. Details like the texture of the earth and wood are clear. The scene extends to more fortifications and open land in the distance.

artworks.title: Portrait of Six Men
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image is a vintage photograph of six men. Three men are standing in the back row, while three are seated in the front row. All individuals have serious expressions and their hair varies in style. The men are dressed in formal attire typical of the late 19th or early 20th century, wearing dark suits, overcoats, ties, and hats such as bowler and flat caps. The two seated men on the far ends have their hands neatly placed on their laps. The photograph is set within an ornate gold frame, and the background consists of a plain backdrop, suggesting a studio setting. The frame features intricate decorative patterns.

artworks.title: Navajo Camp, Manuelito, New Mexico
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a group gathered outdoors near horses and a wagon. The image is rendered in a monochromatic blue tone. The scene captures several figures sitting on blankets on the ground, facing away from the camera. In the background, there are two horses, partially obscured by the figures and foliage, with a wooden wagon wheel visible to the right. The foreground figures are in shadow, creating a silhouette effect against the softly blurred backdrop. The natural surroundings include indistinct trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Pulpit Rock, Echo Canyon, Utah
artworks.artist: William Henry Jackson, Detroit Photographic Company
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon

artworks.title: Washington Bridge and Speedway, New York
artworks.artist: William Henry Jackson, Detroit Photographic Company
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon

artworks.title: American Falls from Goat Island
artworks.artist: William Henry Jackson, Detroit Photographic Company
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This photograph shows a white-and-blue waterfall on the right cascading over a rocky edge into a misty river below on the left. There are large brown rocks in the bottom left corner, the white spray from the waterfall partially obscuring them. Beside the waterfall, on the far right, is a viewing platform with a fence and greenery. A bridge stretches across the scene in the distance on the left, connecting the land on either side of the pale blue river. Greenery extends into the distance beyond the bridge. The sky has fluffy white and gray clouds against a pale blue background.

artworks.title: The Pass Finders, Piegan, Montana
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a sepia-toned photograph of a group of people riding horses that stand on a grassy field with mountain peaks in the background. The people and horses are in a horizontal line across the photograph, all facing the left. The people have dark skin and black hair tied in two braids, many of which are adorned with long black-and-white feathers. They wear long pants, some with tassels or fringe, and many of them appear to have bare chests. The person on the far left has several strands of white beads around their neck and down their chest, and the person behind them holds a long spear. The backdrop consists of light gray mountains with snow caps against a pale sky.

artworks.title: Up the Cutbank, Piegan, Montana
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a sepia-toned photograph that shows a landscape filled with tall, dark trees with white teepees nestled among them. The trees and teepees are seen across a body of water, perhaps a river, that stretches across the bottom of the photograph. A group of five people are visible sitting by the riverbank in front of one of the white teepees, but details about them are hard to see. Next to them, on the right, smoke rises from a fire with a pot hung over it.  In the distance there are tall mountains.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing in a formal pose. He has a serious expression and is dressed in a long-sleeved shirt, trousers, and striped socks. The background is dark, and the portrait is set on a piece of aged paper with a sepia border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Mother and Four Children
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a group portrait of five individuals - a woman and four children. The woman is seated in the center holding a small child on her lap. The woman has her hair styled back and wears a dark dress with gloves. The child on her lap wears a bright garment with a lace collar. To the woman's left are two young girls with shoulder-length hair. They wear white blouses with lace collars over dark skirts. To the woman's right stands a young boy in a dark suit with a high collar. The background is a plain gradient, transitioning from dark at the bottom to lighter shades at the top.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a family portrait with five individuals, consisting of two adults and three children. The adults are seated and the children are standing. The man stands centrally behind the others. He has a neatly trimmed hairstyle and wears a formal suit with a bow tie, characterized by a classic white shirt and dark jacket. The woman sits beside him, wearing a long, dark, full-skirted dress with laced cuffs and collar. Her hair is styled in a middle part and neatly pulled back. She holds a white handkerchief in her left hand and supports two of the children with her arms. The children are dressed in period clothing with decorative details, and one child holds a soft toy. The background features a plain wall complemented by an elegant draped curtain to one side.

artworks.title: Portrait of a First Lieutenant, Infantry
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He is positioned slightly to the side with his left hand resting on a marble pillar. The man has short brown hair and a full beard. He is wearing a dark blue military uniform with gold buttons and shoulder epaulettes, complemented by light blue trousers. In his right hand, he holds a dark hat, while a black belt with a gold buckle secures his uniform at the waist, and a sword hangs from it. White gloves cover his hands. The background features a scenic landscape with a river, greenery, and hills under a blue sky. The setting appears to be both indoors and outdoor, with a large brown curtain draping beside the pillar and a stone urn in the background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated and facing forward. He has fair skin, an oval face, and neatly coiffed brown hair. He appears well-groomed and is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt, a black bow tie, and a chain on his vest. A white handkerchief is visible in his breast pocket. The background includes a red curtain, a textured wall, and a bookshelf.

artworks.title: Sophie Hartman
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This oval photograph features a seated woman, her body turned slightly to the right and her face turned towards us. She has pale skin, arched eyebrows, and thin lips with a hint of a smile. Her dark hair is styled up with pale blue flower decorations around her ears, and she wears a black dress with a white collar and a dark blue brooch. Her hands are placed on her lap, and she sits on a chair with a cushioned green backrest. On the right is a small side table covered with a green cloth that her left arm rests on top of. A red curtain is visible in the background to the right, and the background on the left is flat gray. The oval photograph is surrounded by a beige border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a man in an oval-shaped portrait. He has a full beard and mustache, with short hair and is dressed in a dark jacket with buttons down the center. The portrait is framed in a large, ornate frame with golden and black colors and floral patterns. The background behind the man is a plain light tint.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts a young girl in a full-body portrait. She is standing upright with her right hand resting on a rock, holding a small basket with her left hand. The girl has long, light brown hair tied back with bangs, wearing a long-sleeved burgundy dress with a white lace collar, maroon stockings, and brown boots. Lace trim is visible at the hem of the dress. The background shows a landscape with green hills, a river, and an open sky. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame within an ornate wooden frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl standing in a studio setting. She is positioned with one hand on a red upholstered chair with a prominent pattern, while her other arm hangs by her side. Her facial features reveal a serious expression with wide eyes and a small mouth. Her hair is parted in the middle and pulled back neatly. The girl is dressed in a dark blue dress with a velvet texture, a lace collar, and a pendant necklace at her neck. The dress features a layered skirt with pleats, and she wears dark high boots laced up. The background is a plain, muted tone, giving focus to the girl and the chair. The setting appears old-fashioned.
